attempted_axis: Second-wave de-fakematch pass, game/world/gauntworld.c (work_claim.gauntworld-defake2.20260830.v1): reconcile local WorldLevel typedef with include/game/leveldata.h's level_data (claim.gcurlevel-is-level-data.20260830.v2); convert every raw-offset gCurLevel/WorldLevel-float-tail access to named level_data fields.

attributes.design_decision: Skipped the literal `typedef level_data WorldLevel;` alias (task's suggested route): ResolveWorldDataPointers already uses local WorldLevel's own spellings (cameraIdx/flags2/resolved/bossType/...) and is byte-exact MATCHED; a full alias forces renaming flags2->enabled/resolved->setup, adopting Xbox names NOT GC-verified, for zero benefit on an exact fn. Instead only gCurLevel itself is retyped `extern level_data* gCurLevel;` (matches enemy.c/items.c convention), cast at its one assignment site (ResolveWorldData: `gCurLevel = (level_data*)&gWorldData->levels[level];`), plus cosmetic ->bossType to ->bosstype rename. WorldLevel struct/ResolveWorldDataPointers spellings otherwise untouched.
attributes.gcurlevel_conversion: 10 raw sites, 3 fns, all converted. fn_8005C1DC: 0x9C plevel x2, 0xCC gen_health x1, 0xDC trap_damage x2. fn_800606FC: 0xD8 trap_rate x2, 0xDC trap_damage x1. fn_80060114: `gCurLevel + 180` (no u8* cast, x2) -> ->ene_visrad - a LATENT BUG not just an unnamed offset: without the cast it scaled by sizeof(level_data)=0x10C instead of 1 byte. fnasm.py TARGET showed both sites do `lwz r3,0(0) @gCurLevel; lfs f0,180(r3)` (byte 0xB4 = ene_visrad, new GC anchor).
